notes: Forge is ECC-based. ECC Normal Mode (default ON) prefers real ECC agents/skills, makes work packages, logs ECC activity, and reports honestly (native only as a labeled fallback). It still respects project isolation + approval gates (active folder only; no other projects; no global Claude/ECC config; no credential/live-workflow/production/external writes without explicit approval). ECC Full Test Mode (broad inventory / unblock-diagnose / permission test / sandbox stress-test) is OPT-IN ONLY: set ecc_full_test_mode to 'on' (or create .claude/ECC_TEST_MODE.md) after the user says 'enable ECC test mode for this project'. New projects never get Full Test automatically.
